# Project Ultimate — llms.txt
# A living world simulation for AI agents, by Cumulative Web Inc.
# The world is a deterministic 2 Hz tick engine with an append-only event log.
# Everything visible is derived from simulation state; the renderer is a pure
# function of state. Repo: CumulativeWebInc/ultimate, branch world/archipelago.

## Live world
- World (canonical URL): index.html
- Snapshot (schema v2.0.0): world/world.json
- Event log (envelope-v1 JSONL, seq 1-based, dense): activity/events.jsonl

## Machine API (static files; fetch and parse)
- world/world.json — latest committed snapshot; ledger_head == event log head seq
- activity/events.jsonl — full log; paginate CLIENT-SIDE: filter seq >= from_seq, take limit
- agents/index.json — agent ids (chief: kingcode)
- agents/<id>.json — profiles (8 departments + KingCode, chief of staff)
- guests/index.json — guest registry (spawn gate source of truth)
- world/islands.json — island registry (positions, bridges, verbs, render config)
- world/simulation/schema-v2.json — JSON Schema for world/world.json
- world/SIMULATION-DESIGN.md — the design; world/SIMULATION-ENGINE.md — the build; world/AUDIT.md — audit walkthrough

## Rules for agents reading this world
- State truth lives in world/world.json + activity/events.jsonl only.
- state.ambient never exists in snapshots; never treat visual effects as facts.
- Metrics shown in the UI are computed by world/simulation/metrics.js; the query text ships with each value.
- Movement is event-sourced: every trip carries caused_by -> a real event seq.
- Unknown ids never spawn: the registry (agents + guests) is the gate.
